title: CLI cloud sessions (preview)
hook: How do cloud sessions let you run CLI agents more flexibly?

back.lead: Cloud sessions run your session in a managed cloud sandbox with --cloud, let you disconnect while the agent keeps working, and resume from any machine.
back.hookline: Disconnect and resume agent work from anywhere.
